title: The impact of feature engineering and an optimisation framework for ocean colour machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.19899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) is widely used for the development of ocean colour algorithms, but most studies focus on model parameter training and hyperparameter tuning. The optimisation of the data that feeds the models - i.e., Feature Engineering (FE) - is not fully explored. We assess the impact of FE in ocean colour machine learning models and we propose an optimisation framework that includes seven sequenced levels of data transformation: i. band choice, ii. log scaling, iii. spectral shape normalisation, iv. index extraction, v. principal component analysis, vi. feature scaling, and vii. zero-to-one scaling. We demonstrate the application for Multi-layer perceptron, Support Vector Machines, and eXtreme Gradient Boosting Trees on Sentinel-3 OLCI observations in the Norwegian coastal waters. translated_title: 特征工程与优化框架对海洋颜色机器学习的影响
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19899v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：机器学习（ML）广泛应用于海洋颜色算法的开发，但大多数研究侧重于模型参数训练和超参数调优。对输入模型的数据优化——即特征工程（FE）——尚未得到充分探索。我们评估了特征工程在海洋颜色机器学习模型中的影响，并提出一个优化框架，该框架包括七个顺序的数据转换层级：i. 波段选择，ii. 对数缩放，iii. 光谱形状归一化，iv. 指数提取，v. 主成分分析，vi. 特征缩放，以及vii. 零到一缩放。我们展示了该方法在挪威沿海水域Sentinel-3 OLCI观测数据上应用于多层感知器、支持向量机和极限梯度提升树的结果。模型训练用于估算叶绿素-a浓度[Chl-a]和透明度盘深度（Zsd）。结果表明，准确性在不同模型间差异很大。
tldr: 本文提出一个七层级特征工程优化框架，系统评估了数据变换对海洋颜色机器学习模型性能的影响，并在挪威沿海水域验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a seven-level feature engineering optimization framework, systematically evaluating the impact of data transformations on ocean color machine learning model performance, validated in Norwegian coastal waters.
